First-time setup

Everything this site needs lives in this single HTML file — the app and its Supabase configuration. Run the SQL below once in your Supabase project (SQL Editor) to create the tables, Row Level Security policies and storage buckets, then create your admin user and authorize it. Full instructions are in supabase/SETUP.md.

  1. Enable Firestore Database (start in production mode) and Authentication → Email/Password for the ramzi-drok project. No Cloud Storage is needed — images you upload are compressed and stored inside your Firestore database, so everyone can see them.
  2. Create the admin account: Authentication → Users → Add user using the email in AURA_CONFIG.ADMIN_EMAIL and your chosen password. (The first unlock can also create it automatically while ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP is on — turn that off afterwards.)
  3. Paste the Firestore rules below into Firestore Database → Rules and click Publish. Only that one admin account can write; everyone can read the public content.
  4. Close public sign-ups so nobody else can create an account: Authentication → Settings → User actions and turn off “Allow new users to sign up”. The site never offers a sign-up form.
  5. Open the site and click the site name 5 times quickly — the password dialog appears. Enter your password.
